artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 7 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a chariot pulled by two horses named "Audatia" and "Magnanimitas." The horses are decked in detailed harnesses and are being reined by figures holding branches. The scene is set in motion with dynamic lines depicting movement, with minimal surroundings. Latin text above the image provides additional context.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Chariot of Maximilian I (The Great Triumphal Car) [plate 8 of 8]
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Harold P. Morris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a chariot drawn by horses. The image shows a detailed illustration of a chariot group on the bottom portion, with richly adorned horses being led. Around the drawing, especially in the upper half, there is heavy text content in Latin. The horses are detailed with ornate harnesses and manes, and the presence of two figures holding wreaths titled "Experientia" and "Solertia" suggests symbolic representation of Experience and Virtue. The overall style and execution bear characteristics of a high Renaissance or classical woodcut engraving.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ
artworks.medium: colored chalks on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in various positions, viewed from the waist up or in three-quarter view. One figure appears to be leaning forward, partially obscured by a column; their facial features are soft and not clearly defined, with long flowing hair. Other figures in the composition seem to be bending or kneeling, engaged in a dynamic scene. The attire visible includes draped garments with some having hues of red and green. No jewelry or objects are prominently displayed in their hands. The background is loosely defined, with architectural elements like columns and arches, rendered in soft, muted tones that blend with the figures.

artworks.title: Figure Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of human figures in different poses. Various sketches of human forms in dynamic positions are shown, some intertwined with others and some standalone. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, conveying movement. The style is reminiscent of Michelangelo, focusing on human anatomy and movement studies. This page could be a preparatory sheet where the artist tested different poses and compositions, emphasizing accurate anatomical representation and expressive posture.

artworks.title: Figure Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper (red chalk line across center)
artworks.description: Drawings of bodies fill the left half of this vertical, parchment-colored paper, and writing fills the right half. The drawings and writing are in dark brown ink, and lines from the other side of the sheet show through, creating blurred forms. On the left, several nude male bodies are loosely drawn and appear upside down in this view. Their actions are indistinct but they gesture and turn. The right half is filled with horizontal lines of hand-written text and numbers. A vertical line splitting the two halves was presumably made when folded in half at some point in the sheet's history.

artworks.title: A View of the Pont Neuf, the Mint, etc.: pl.8
artworks.medium: retouched etching
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a bridge spanning the river. In the foreground, people and animals are engaged in various activities along the walkway. The scene is depicted with intricate architectural details and a warm color palette, with the bridge and buildings reflected on the water's surface.

artworks.title: Hunters Resting by a River
artworks.medium: sanguine chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 28.2 x 46.4 cm (11 1/8 x 18 1/4 in.)
support: 33.5 x 52.1 cm (13 3/16 x 20 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall trees on the left side, fields stretching towards the horizon, and a sky dominating the upper half. The horizon has silhouettes of trees and hills. Birds fly diagonally in the sky, adding movement. The style features detailed yet loose brushstrokes, especially in trees and figures. The color palette is sepia. Figures are present near a tree and further back, engaged in leisure activities. Gentle hills with trees are in the background.

artworks.title: Vue du chateau de Madrid
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a river running through a rural area. Hills, buildings, including a castle or manor, and trees are visible. The etching has fine details in the trees, clouds, and water. It uses varying shades of gray and black. The foreground has cottages, figures, and a textured landscape leading to the river. In the distance, more structures and vegetation are visible, enhancing the vastness of the scene.

artworks.title: Cart Filled with Wounded Soldiers (Chariot charge de soldats blesses)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded carriage being pulled by three horses. The horses are detailed with a strong sense of motion and tension. The carriage is loaded with figures in historical clothing. Some figures appear to be interacting. Two men are depicted in the foreground and background, appearing to direct the horses. The drawing conveys movement and activity, with a monochromatic color scheme emphasizing the historical feel.

artworks.title: Joseph Identifying Himself to His Brothers
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an outdoor setting. On the right, a standing man is in motion, arms slightly extended, wearing long robes. Surrounding him are other men kneeling or crouching, also in robes. One of the kneeling figures is slightly off-center, reaching out a hand towards the standing man. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches, along with trees and a hilly landscape with buildings in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Grotesque Strip with Dragon, Shields and Wild Men
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mythical creature surrounded by ornate floral designs and shields. The painting features a stylized representation of a beast or dragon with an elaborate mane and bearded face, depicted in a deep, earthy yellow hue against a contrasting dark background. Detailed floral and organic patterns in shades of red and brown envelop the creature, providing a sense of movement and fluidity. Ornamental shields in red with diagonal white stripes flank the creature on either side. The style is reminiscent of Medieval European woodcut illumination, suggestive of mythological themes displayed in decorative borders. The intricate details and color palette convey a sense of depth and artistry typical of such medieval decorative works.

artworks.title: Broadside with Two Scenes from the Life of Christ, and Grotesque Borders
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is an image containing dense blackletter German text and contrasting illustrations. The left illustration shows a crowned figure seated with a child on their lap, while the right illustration depicts a crucifixion scene with three figures on crosses. The border features floral and vine patterns.

artworks.title: Coast Scene with an Artist (Le dessinateur)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.5 x 17.7 cm (4 15/16 x 6 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a fortified structure on the left, a path leading towards the water, figures engaging in various activities in the center, and ships in the sea in the background. The style features intricate linework and cross-hatching to depict texture and depth. The color palette consists of various shades of brown and black, with a monochromatic feel. The sky has thin horizontal strokes suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: A Gentleman with a Walking Stick
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a dynamic stance with one foot slightly raised. They are positioned sideways, with one arm extended forward holding a cane and the other arm out to the side. The individual has a simplistic facial expression, pointy hair, and is dressed in a flowing coat, vest, and form-fitting pants. The background is plain with a textured paper.

artworks.title: Drapery Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped fabric studies. The image displays several sketches of draped cloth, each study showing different arrangements and angles to capture the way the fabric folds and flows. The pencil strokes are delicate and precise, with shading used to give depth and definition to the creases and layers of the material. The texture of the paper can be seen beneath the drawing. Each portion of the cloth appears almost lifelike due to the careful observation and rendering of light and shadow by the artist.

artworks.title: Baby [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a young child shown from the side and partially from behind, including the head, torso, arms, and legs. The child is reclining, with the head turned slightly to the left. The sketch features delicate facial features, suggesting round cheeks, a small nose, and a subtle mouth. The hair is depicted with soft, wavy lines indicating short, voluminous curls. The child is not clothed, and there are no visible objects in the scene. The sketch is on a plain textured background resembling aged paper.

artworks.title: Ascension of the Magdalene
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25 x 40 cm (9 13/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
support: 29.5 x 43.2 cm (11 5/8 x 17 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical figure with outstretched arms and a set of detailed sketches of hands below it. The primary figure in the drawing appears to be sketching the upper torso and head of a person seen from below and to the side. The figure's arms are extended wide. The drawing also contains multiple smaller sketches of hands in various gestures and positions. The artwork employs thin lines and subtle shading, using pencil or graphite on aged paper.

artworks.title: Archer Drawing His Bow
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 23.2 x 13.2 cm (9 1/8 x 5 3/16 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing and drawing a bow. The individual is in profile, facing slightly to the right, with one leg forward. The person has a focused expression and wears a hat with feathers, ornate clothing, including puffed sleeves and a pleated skirt, and an archer's glove on their right hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed figure.

artworks.title: Frederik Hendrik, Prince of Nassau-Orange
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Adriaen Pietersz van de Venne
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image features a half-body portrait of a person standing in a relaxed posture. The individual is holding a baton, with one hand on their hip. They have finely detailed facial features, a trimmed beard, and a mustache. The person is dressed in an elaborate, formal attire, including a large ruffled collar, a tall wide-brimmed hat with a feather, and draped fabric over one shoulder. A suit of armor is placed behind the individual. The background shows an architectural setting with archways leading to an exterior view where a few figures are conversing, and a dog is standing nearby.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Nude Men and a Dog
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I after Gillis Mostaert
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains and hills in the distance, trees scattered around, and clouds in the sky. In the foreground, two figures sit under trees. The scene is created with intricate etching in monochrome tones, depicting various textures and details.

artworks.title: Scene with a Tower to the Left
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a gently sloping terrain leading to a body of water. A wooden boat is moored at the shore. An old rustic building with a bell tower is on the left surrounded by sparse trees and figures engaged in daily activities. Further away, there is a serene body of water dotted with small boats and a flag-bearing ship. The horizon is placed towards the upper third of the image. A larger structure is seen on a hill overlooking the water. The brushstrokes are detailed with an emphasis on line work. The color palette consists of soft pastel shades of browns, blues, and greens creating a calm visual atmosphere.

artworks.title: Drawing for a Fan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, watercolor, and gouache over graphite on laid paper, verso reddened (for transfer?)
artworks.description: This is a painting of cherubic figures dancing amidst wispy clouds. The figures are depicted within a semicircular frame. The scene is set against a serene, ethereal blue sky, with the figures entwined in flowing drapery and holding floral garlands. The overall atmosphere is one of lightness and whimsy, with a delicate interplay of soft pastel colors.

artworks.title: The Chamber Idyll
artworks.medium: wood engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene viewed through a wooden frame. The image features two seated figures within a cozy, rustic cabin-like setting. They are seated on rustic chairs with a basket of fruit nearby. The interior includes elements such as a window with a latticed grid, draped fabrics, and various old-world decorative pieces. The background shows a night sky with stars and a landscape with trees and what appears to be a grazing animal. The style of the drawing focuses on texture and light and shadow.

artworks.title: Sara Wearing a Bonnet and Coat
artworks.medium: pastel over pastel counterproof on chine collé
artworks.description: The artwork shows the head and upper shoulders of a young girl in a three-quarter view. Her head is slightly turned to the right, revealing a smile. The girl has brown hair and is wearing a broad-brimmed hat with pastel strokes. She has a high-collared light-colored garment. The background is plain and neutral. There are no visible signs of jewelry or additional objects in the frame.
